name: unequal logits
test:
import math
out = softmax([0.0, math.log(3.0)])
assert len(out) == 2 and abs(out[0] - 0.25) < 1e-9 and abs(out[1] - 0.75) < 1e-9

name: equal logits
test:
out = softmax([4.0, 4.0, 4.0])
assert len(out) == 3 and all(abs(x - 1/3) < 1e-9 for x in out)

name: large positive offset
test:
import math
out = softmax([1000.0, 1000.0])
assert len(out) == 2 and all(math.isfinite(x) and abs(x - 0.5) < 1e-9 for x in out)

name: large negative offset
test:
import math
out = softmax([-1000.0, -1001.0])
expected = 1.0 / (1.0 + math.exp(-1.0))
assert len(out) == 2 and abs(out[0] - expected) < 1e-9 and abs(sum(out) - 1) < 1e-9

name: shift invariance and immutability
test:
base = [-2.0, 0.5, 3.0]
before = base[:]
a = softmax(base)
b = softmax([x + 500 for x in base])
assert base == before and len(a) == len(b) == 3
assert all(abs(x - y) < 1e-9 for x, y in zip(a, b))
assert all(0 <= x <= 1 for x in a) and abs(sum(a) - 1) < 1e-9
